entities.summary:
Russia is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Moscow. Official languages include Russian. Government: Federal semi-presidential republic (de facto authoritarian). Population: approximately 144.8 million. Area: 17,098,242 km². Comprehensive index for Russia covering Kievan Rus' (9th-13th century), Mongol invasion/Golden Horde (1237-1480), rise of Moscow, Ivan the Terrible (first Tsar 1547), Time of Troubles, Romanov dynasty (1613-1917), Peter the Great/St.

Petersburg, Catherine the Great, Napoleon's invasion 1812, Crimean War, serfdom abolition 1861, Russo-Japanese War 1904-05, 1905 Revolution, WWI, February/October Revolutions 1917, Russian Civil War, Soviet Union (1922-91, Lenin/Stalin/Khrushchev/Brezhnev/Gorbachev), WWII/Great Patriotic War, Cold War, Gorbachev/Perestroika/Glasnost, USSR collapse 1991, Yeltsin era, Putin, Ukraine war 2022.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Russia's rise to power and subsequent Soviet Union had a profound impact on world politics, shaping two global conflicts (WWII and Cold War) that involved nearly every nation. The country's population of approximately 144.8 million has played a significant role in international relations.
